name: chatwoot-discord
description: Mirror Chatwoot conversations into a Discord forum and handle tickets with Discord commands.

CONFIG.description: Non-secret settings (JSON): Chatwoot URL, accounts and their forum channels, linked agents, and the optional triage bot. The committed values are placeholders; see the [configuration reference](https://github.com/Phala-Network/chatwoot-discord#configuration-reference).

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Bot token of your Discord application (Developer Portal > your application > **Bot**).

DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY.description: **Public Key** of your Discord application (Developer Portal > your application > **General Information**), 64 hex characters.

CHATWOOT_RELAY_TOKEN.description: Access token (Profile > Access Token) of a Chatwoot user that is an agent in every relayed inbox, or an administrator.

CHATWOOT_WEBHOOK_SECRETS.description: JSON object of Chatwoot webhook secrets by account id, e.g. `{"1":"<secret>"}` (Settings > Integrations > Webhooks).

CHATWOOT_AGENT_TOKENS.description: JSON object of each linked agent's own Chatwoot access token by Discord user id, e.g. `{"<Discord user id>":"<token>"}`. Use `{}` until agents are linked.
